name: reshma-core-api
description: The highly scalable, polymorphic backend engine powering the Reshma Bangles & Boutique B2C e-commerce platform.
author: Md Afzal Ansari

scripts.test:docker:unit: docker compose -f docker/test/docker-compose.test.yml --profile unit up --abort-on-container-exit --exit-code-from test-runner
scripts.test:docker:integration: docker compose -f docker/test/docker-compose.test.yml --profile integration up --build --abort-on-container-exit --exit-code-from test-integration
scripts.test:docker:e2e: docker compose -f docker/test/docker-compose.test.yml --profile e2e up --abort-on-container-exit --exit-code-from test-e2e
scripts.test:docker:workers: docker compose -f docker/test/docker-compose.test.yml --profile workers up --abort-on-container-exit --exit-code-from test-workers
scripts.test:docker:security: docker compose -f docker/test/docker-compose.test.yml --profile security up --abort-on-container-exit --exit-code-from test-security
scripts.test:docker:all: docker compose -f docker/test/docker-compose.test.yml --profile unit --profile integration --profile e2e --profile workers --profile security up --abort-on-container-exit
scripts.test:cov:unit: docker compose -f docker/test/docker-compose.test.yml --profile unit run --rm test-runner npx jest --config jest.config.unit.ts --coverage --coverageReporters=text --coverageReporters=text-summary --coverageReporters=json-summary --runInBand
scripts.test:cov:integration: docker compose -f docker/test/docker-compose.test.yml --profile integration run --rm test-integration npx jest --config jest.config.integration.ts --coverage --coverageReporters=text --coverageReporters=text-summary --coverageReporters=json-summary --runInBand
scripts.test:cov:security: docker compose -f docker/test/docker-compose.test.yml --profile security run --rm test-security npx jest --config jest.config.security.ts --coverage --coverageReporters=text --coverageReporters=text-summary --coverageReporters=json-summary --runInBand
scripts.test:cov:e2e: docker compose -f docker/test/docker-compose.test.yml --profile e2e run --rm test-e2e npx jest --config jest.config.e2e.ts --coverage --coverageReporters=text --coverageReporters=text-summary --coverageReporters=json-summary --runInBand
scripts.test:cov:workers: docker compose -f docker/test/docker-compose.test.yml --profile workers run --rm test-workers npx jest --config jest.config.workers.ts --coverage --coverageReporters=text --coverageReporters=text-summary --coverageReporters=json-summary --runInBand
